tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GWN7052 1270Mbps Dual Band Gigabit WiFi Router is a powerful networking solution designed for both home and small business environments With advanced wireless technology and strong security features this router ensures fast stable and secure internet connectivity for multiple devices


Equipped with dual band WiFi the GWN7052 delivers speeds up to 1270Mbps allowing smooth streaming gaming and browsing Its MU MIMO technology improves performance by supporting multiple users at the same time without slowing down


This router also includes built in VPN support making it ideal for secure remote access With Gigabit WAN and LAN ports users can enjoy high speed wired connections along with reliable wireless coverage


Key Features


  • Up to 1270Mbps Dual Band WiFi Speed
  • Supports 2 point 4GHz and 5GHz bands for stable connectivity
  • 2 by 2 MU MIMO technology
  • Built in VPN support including IPSec OpenVPN and L2TP
  • One Gigabit WAN port and four Gigabit LAN ports
  • Advanced firewall and network security
  • Supports up to 100 connected devices
  • Suitable for home office and business use
